pages.title: The Road to the Crown
pages.text: The City Manager's $(l)Quests$() page follows one quest line from your first charter to a crown, in five chapters:$(li)A Charter and a Hearth$(li)Stone and Scholarship$(li)Walls and Watchmen$(li)The Realm Widens$(li)The Crown

Steps complete by themselves when your kingdom gets there: a town hall, a rank, a research, walls, a raid held off, a second city, a truce, the Capital Castle. Only the current chapter counts, and each step pays once: emeralds, items, stockpile goods, research or merit for your soldiers. A toast and a chime mark each one.

pages.title: Town bounties
pages.text: Each town posts up to three bounties from what it needs:$(li)$(l)Deliver$() what its builders are short of, or bread when the granary is low.$(li)$(l)Slay$() hostile mobs near the town.$(li)$(l)Patrol$() the four posts at the town's edge; beams of light and the City Map show where.

pages.title: Escorts
pages.text: While one of its caravans loads at the market, a town also posts $(l)Escort our caravan$(). Take it, meet the caravan, and stay within 16 blocks of it for most of the road until it reaches its market. Walking with it halves the risk of an ambush.

Accept a bounty on the board; you may hold three at once. Bounties expire after three days (a taken one always has at least a day). Rewards are emeralds and grow with the town's rank. Independent towns post bounties too, unless you are at war with them.$(br2)Pack makers: the quest line is data, in $(l)data/<ns>/livingrealms_quests/$().
